limitations: Isolated Linux Chromium, Classic/Feyz. No user recording/profile is read. Autoplay is enabled by the fixture; real Android gesture restrictions are unmeasured. Visibility is simulated; physical Android screen locking and audible output are unmeasured.

The first case uses the shipped Arabic bank without copying audio to personal storage. Kalem has no bundle; its pending-probe test uses a generated tone solely as a transport fixture, with no recitation-content claim. The second deliberately controls the preliminary duration probe and optional processing; actual persistent HTMLMediaElement metadata, playback and clocks are unmodified.
